description: Regression for r5:F3 / r4:WS-5 and LV-2 / RV-4: on Shooting-phase entry the panel auto-selects the first eligible shooter; that selection is a REAL SELECT_SHOOTER the phase receives (Main connects the controller's action signal before set_phase), but — because the player has not chosen the unit — it does NOT open the unit_selected_to_shoot window (LV-2). The controller's single-target auto-assign reaches the phase without opening it either; the player's first real action with the shooter (Confirm Targets, or Quick-Assign when shown) opens it BEFORE that action is applied. Setup-only: P1 switched to Kult of Speed, every P1 unit except the Deffkoptas marked has_shot, Custodian Guard C moved unengaged in front of the Ork rank with inflated wounds. Real END_COMMAND + END_MOVEMENT transitions reach the Shooting phase; no prompt at phase entry; a real Confirm click opens the DAKKASTORM window; a real click on Use spends 1 CP and the held Confirm then resolves; Fast finishes the Deffkoptas' shooting with DAKKASTORM's [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
